short: Count balance and growth conditions sufficient for RH

lean.name: Formalism.LFunctionChainParameters.ThickSetMeanBounds.RiemannHypothesisOfBalanceAndGrowthData
lean.plain: Count balance and growth conditions sufficient for RH
lean.note: Lean proves that a power bound for the smoothed zeta prime sum, hence RH, follows from the balance identity for each finite abelian group and from the required size and error estimates at every sufficiently large scale. This conditional proof sits outside the final dependency cone.
